units.source_text: 此书气品高雅，笔致优美。

en.t: This letter was noble in tone and beautifully written.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王说：“此诗含有怨恨之意，倒很麻烦了。

en.t: But Prince Niou said, “This poem carries a note of resentment, which makes matters rather troublesome.

units.source_text: 其实我目前大可安心在此度日，却想不到发生这意外之事！”

en.t: In truth, I ought to be able to live here in peace for now, but I never expected such an unexpected thing to happen!”

units.source_text: 其实，倘是应守一夫一妻之制的寻常百姓，则丈夫娶了二妻而一妻妒恨，旁人都同情她。

en.t: In fact, if this were an ordinary commoner bound to keep to one wife, and the husband took a second while the first wife grew jealous and resentful, everyone would sympathize with her.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王不能与常人相提并论。

en.t: But Prince Niou cannot be judged by the same measure as ordinary people.

units.source_text: 故终于发生此事，亦属理之当然。

en.t: So it was only natural, in the end, that this should come about.

units.source_text: 世人都认为匂亲王在诸皇子中地位特殊，将来有册立太子之望，

en.t: People generally believed that Prince Niou held a special position among the imperial princes and might one day be named crown prince,

units.source_text: 即使多娶几位夫人，也不致受人讥评。

en.t: so even if he took several wives, he would not be likely to face criticism.

units.source_text: 因此他再娶六女公子，无人替二女公子叫屈。

en.t: For that reason, when he took the Sixth Princess as another wife, no one spoke up in grievance for the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 反之，匂亲王如此郑重其事地优待她，异乎寻常地宠爱她，

en.t: On the contrary, because Prince Niou treated her with such formal care and loved her with such extraordinary favor,

units.source_text: 人都称道二女公子有福气呢。

en.t: everyone praised the Second Princess as a woman blessed with good fortune.

units.source_text: 而二女公子自己心中，只因过去受宠太甚，已成习惯，

en.t: But in the Second Princess’s own heart, she had simply grown used to being too greatly cherished in the past,

units.source_text: 如今忽然被人分爱，不免悲伤愁叹耳。

en.t: and now that his love was suddenly being shared with another, she could not help grieving and lamenting.

units.source_text: 她以前读古代小说，或听人传说，常怪女子为了男子分爱，何必如此深感苦痛。

en.t: In the past, when she read old romances or heard tales from others, she often wondered why women suffered so deeply when a man’s love was divided.

units.source_text: 现在轮到自己身上，方始恍然大悟：此种苦痛确非寻常可比。

en.t: Now that it had happened to her, she finally understood with sudden clarity that this kind of pain was truly beyond ordinary comparison.

units.source_text: 此时匂亲王对二女公子，态度比往常更加温和诚恳，对她说道：“你一点东西也不吃，实在不行！”

en.t: At this time Prince Niou was even gentler and more earnest than usual toward the Second Princess, and said to her, “You are not eating a thing; this really will not do!”

units.source_text: 便把上好的果物送到她面前，又召唤手段高明的厨师，

en.t: He had the finest fruits brought before her and also summoned highly skilled cooks,

units.source_text: 特地为她烹调肴馔，劝她进用。

en.t: ordering them to prepare special dishes for her and urging her to eat.

units.source_text: 但二女公子一点也不想吃。

en.t: But the Second Princess had no desire to eat at all.

units.source_text: 匂亲王叹道：“这真是为难了！”

en.t: Prince Niou sighed, “This is truly difficult!”

units.source_text: 此时天色渐暮，到了傍晚，他就回自己的正殿去。

en.t: By then the sky was gradually darkening, and when evening came, he returned to his own main residence.

units.source_text: 晚风送爽，天色清幽可爱。

en.t: The evening breeze brought coolness, and the sky was clear, quiet, and lovely.

units.source_text: 他原是风流潇洒之人，此时神情更见艳丽。

en.t: He was by nature elegant and graceful, and at this moment his expression appeared still more radiant.

units.source_text: 但忧愁苦闷的二女公子心中，只觉得无限悲伤，难于忍受。

en.t: But in the heart of the Second Princess, sunk in sorrow and anguish, there was only boundless grief, almost impossible to endure.

units.source_text: 她听到蝉鸣之声，思慕宇治山庄，遂吟诗云：

en.t: Hearing the cry of the cicadas, she longed for the villa at Uji and composed this poem:
